meaning: `tol = 1.3e-5` is the relative cycle-to-cycle change at which a simulation is declared periodically steady. It decides how many cardiac cycles are run before the state is accepted as the steady solution.

could_move.what: The accepted steady state itself for every m3 run, since the loop returns as soon as Δ falls under tol (Model_3/Model.jl:22).
Bistability results: whether two initial conditions are judged to land on distinct basins can depend on how tightly each is converged.
Fitted parameters and target search in m3/m6, since the objective is evaluated on the returned steady state.
Plotted traces in the jugular-compression decks that go through the same solver path.

expectation: Direction unknown from the context alone. A looser tol returns earlier and leaves more residual drift; a tighter tol costs more cycles and can hit max_cycles = 4096. I cannot tell from the code whether 1.3e-5 is loose or tight for these models.

check.why: Runs one m3 case that calls solve_to_periodic_steady_state directly (Model_3/bistability_test.jl:127-132) and reports basin outcomes, without re-fitting. Compare the returned states and cycle counts against the current tol and a tighter one.
